Day 28

May 19 2026

Another molt. I also have gold ramshorns. There might be an ivory leopard one too. I dropped the shrimp pellet into the middle of the tank, then used tongs to pick it up and set it on the rock. I watched a smaller shrimp chase all the other shrimp away. It surprised me, how fiercely it pushed against other much larger shrimp. The shrimp are getting bigger. Ebira has a contender now
